subject: modularity test bootstrapping producing identical values

messages.author: a037488cac4435b7
messages.subject: modularity test bootstrapping producing identical values
parts:
Hi all!

I've run into a bizarre issue with the modularity.test (and phylo.modularity) functions. The function is otherwise running fine, but when I select CI = TRUE every resulting CR value (and thus the upper and lower bounds of the confidence interval) is identical. 

This happens with both versions of the function, and isn't just a consequence of my data- it was not happening with the same code a few months ago, and does happen with the plethodon dataset when I run the  phylo.modularity example code (only changing CI = TRUE). I have also tried running my code on a friend's computer with the same result. I'm probably just doing something very silly, but any ideas what might cause this?

Thank you very much!

Anya L. Auerbach
Ph.D. candidate, Reddy Lab
Ecology, Evolution, and Behavior, University of Minnesota

Best,
Mike
